verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents some built-in operations that act on many items at once: broadcasts queue a message to all defined recipients and can be triggered with a single API call. It also documents reverse-ETL warehouse syncs that move data in bulk, and an AI agent that can run recurring segment audits. The CLI and MCP give AI agents full workspace access with structured JSON. However, the evidence never documents a batch or bulk endpoint, or an agent workflow for bulk edits, updates or deletes across many profiles, automations or segments. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API or CLI operations for mass updates or deletes, AI-driven bulk editing across many items, limits/atomicity details for bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
